references.text: Parallel text to the Ten Commandments in Exodus, which contains the same command not to have other gods.
The Lord declares himself a jealous God and forbids worship of other gods.
The Lord proclaims that he is the first and the last, and that there is no other God.
The Lord declares that he is God, and there is no other.
The Lord reminds Israel that they shall know no other God but him.
Jesus quotes the command to worship the Lord your God alone when he is tempted by Satan.
Paul confirms that there is only one God, the Father, and one Lord, Jesus Christ.
Affirms faith in one God and Father of all.
